description: This file defines various Django forms used in a recipe management web application, including import/export, invite links, space creation/join, user signup, password reset, and user creation forms.

classes.name: SelectWidget
classes.description: Custom select widget with associated JavaScript media.

classes.name: MultiSelectWidget
classes.description: Custom multi-select widget with associated JavaScript media.

classes.name: ImportExportBase
classes.description: Base form for import/export operations with predefined choices for different services.

classes.name: MultipleFileInput
classes.description: Custom file input allowing multiple file selection.

classes.name: MultipleFileField
classes.description: Form field for handling multiple file uploads.

classes.name: ImportForm
classes.description: Form for importing recipes with options for duplicates, meal plans, shopping lists, and nutrition info.

classes.name: ExportForm
classes.description: Form for exporting recipes with filtering options.

classes.name: InviteLinkForm
classes.description: Form for creating and validating invite links for spaces.

classes.name: SpaceCreateForm
classes.description: Form for creating new spaces with name validation.

classes.name: SpaceJoinForm
classes.description: Form for joining spaces via token.

classes.name: AllAuthSignupForm
classes.description: Extended signup form with CAPTCHA and terms acceptance.

classes.name: AllAuthSocialSignupForm
classes.description: Social signup form with terms acceptance.

classes.name: UserCreateForm
classes.description: Form for creating a new user with username and password.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Placeholder method for user signup process in signup forms.
